text: Based on the Earth-observation data, the tree cover on this asset has not significantly changed since 2020. The land was 48.4 hectares of tree cover in 2000 (Hansen data), and 43.3 hectares (11.55% of the asset) was still classified as forest in 2020 (JRC data). The latest analysis (2025) shows no major land-cover changes meeting the 0.5-hectare threshold. Both datasets agree on the forest area, confirming stability. No deforestation or regrowth events were detected post-2020.
